asins.description: Amazon ASINs to fetch exactly. Each ASIN opens its own product page (/dp/{ASIN}) directly, never a keyword search.
asins.title: ASINs

categoryNodeIds.description: Amazon browse-node IDs. Each node builds a real category listing (/s?rh=n:{node}&fs=true), with a merchandising fallback only when Amazon renders no listing grid.
categoryNodeIds.title: Category Node IDs

categoryUrls.description: Amazon search, category, seller-profile, or exact product URLs. Search pages (/s?k=), browse nodes (/b?node=), seller profiles (/sp?seller=), and product pages (/dp/) are routed automatically. Combine with any other mode.
categoryUrls.title: Search, Category & Product URLs

includeSpecifications.description: If true (and detail pages are scraped), return the specifications object parsed from the overview and technical-detail tables.
includeSpecifications.title: Include Specifications

includeSponsored.description: If true (default), sponsored/ad placements are included. Set false to return organic results only.
includeSponsored.title: Include Sponsored Results

keywords.description: Plain search keywords or phrases. Each keyword builds an Amazon search URL (/s?k={query}).
keywords.title: Search Keywords

marketplaceDomain.description: Amazon marketplace used for keyword, ASIN, seller, and node modes. URLs in categoryUrls/productUrls keep their own marketplace.
marketplaceDomain.title: Marketplace

maxItems.description: Global cap across every source in the run. 0 means no global cap.
maxItems.title: Maximum Items (all sources)

maxItemsPerCategory.description: Maximum products to return from each keyword, URL, seller, or node source.
maxItemsPerCategory.title: Maximum Items Per Source

maxPages.description: Maximum listing pages per source. Amazon keyword search itself stops at page 7; category listings go deeper.
maxPages.title: Maximum Pages

minRating.description: Only return products with a star rating at or above this value (0-5).
minRating.title: Minimum Rating

onlyDeals.description: If true, only return products with visible deal evidence (coupon, limited-time-deal badge, or genuine strike-through list price).
onlyDeals.title: Only Deals

priceMax.description: Only return products priced at or below this amount (marketplace currency).
priceMax.title: Maximum Price

priceMin.description: Only return products priced at or above this amount (marketplace currency).
priceMin.title: Minimum Price

primeOnly.description: If true, only return products with a visible Amazon Prime badge. Badges are render-dependent in some marketplaces.
primeOnly.title: Prime Only

productUrls.description: Exact Amazon product URLs. Each URL is normalized to /dp/{ASIN} on its own marketplace and fetched directly (never as a search).
productUrls.title: Product URLs

rateLimitDelay.description: Base pacing delay between live requests. Product-detail requests always add human-like jitter.
rateLimitDelay.title: Base Request Delay (seconds)

scrapeProductDetails.description: If true, visit each accepted product's own page for specs, gallery images, seller, BSR, variants, and histogram. ASIN/product-URL modes always use detail pages. If false, only listing-card fields are returned.
scrapeProductDetails.title: Scrape Product Details

sellerIds.description: Amazon seller/merchant IDs. Each ID builds that seller's storefront listing (/s?me={sellerId}).
sellerIds.title: Seller IDs

sortBy.description: Sort order applied to search and category listings.
sortBy.title: Sort By
